mature_contract: Use saved forward H11 operating profit, noncurrent net cash investment and NWC investment; grow each nominal cash item at 2.5% thereafter. Capital stock accumulates these investments, not instant g times H10 capital.
bridge_rate_reason: Keep contractual financing/commitment cash under one baseline owner opportunity-cost budget, separate from operating-risk endpoint rates. 10% is not asserted to be a risk-free rate.
auxiliary_maintenance_allowance: Full saved H5 cash capex including capitalized R&D; no release of the possible growth portion, no extra expensed-R&D deduction, no SBC addback.
point_semantics: Selected initial accounting-feasible ownership witnesses carried conditionally; not global current or year5 ownership extrema.
